request: Restore recommended mode at the top; requirements accessible inside each mode card; optional info/help dialogs instead of hiding essential UI behind dropdowns.
changes: Recommendation panel leads scanner setup with actual backend reason, warning and regime. Available, stand-aside and unavailable states stay distinct; application is manual and rechecks freshness.
All four mode cards remain visible on phones, tablets and desktops. Each shows backend default score, R:R, planning timeframe, critical data requirements and analysis timeframes.
Each card has a separate information button opening the shared native dialog for optional description/profile/timeframe-role explanation. Help never selects a mode or starts a scan.
Scan inputs are visible in a labeled responsive grid; existing config handlers, reset/reload and busy disabling remain unchanged.
Result filters use a native dialog beside the result count; existing filters, reset and receipt ownership remain unchanged. Portal range retains a 44px target.
Incomplete mode metadata no longer crashes the page title or displays an invented zero score; unavailable card fields remain explicit.
PRODUCT and DESIGN record the preference. No scan/session/feed/replay/accounting/trading/ML owner or policy changes.

Card score/R:R/planning TF/critical and analysis timeframes use current mode metadata. Missing metadata explicit Unavailable. Recommendation available,stand-aside,unavailable,stale,unknown-mode states sampled. Unknown-mode producer reason retained alongside definition-unavailable cause.

Existing ScannerContext manual mode/config owner retained; ScanController,scanRunService and recommendation hook lifecycle unchanged. FilterRail filters same recorded/displayed signals. Inputs fieldset keeps existing busy guard.

24initial state/width samples;8partial/unknown-mode correction retests;4latestavailable layout checks;4expiry/busy boundaries;12named-dialog keyboard samples;4filtertarget retests;4main-control/contrast samples. No accounting or execution logic change. Explicit unknown card values and original incoming recommendation reasons retained. Existing hook expiry normalization limitation documented separately.

All /api browser requests intercepted. Zero nonGET API attempts and zero uncaught page errors. Initial partial renderer faults were caught by app error boundary and are explicitly recorded.
